helpIntro: Boston University uses a 4.0 honor-point scale. Multiply each GPA-bearing course grade value by its BU units, add the honor points, and divide by GPA-bearing units.
helpNote: For standard undergraduate BU GPA planning. P/P* and other non-honor-point marks are excluded; F/F* count at 0.0 with units. External transfer grades do not enter BU GPA. Repeat Impact is unavailable because BU counts all graded attempts.
helpExample: A 4-unit A earns 16.0 honor points and a 4-unit B+ earns 13.2. Together, 29.2 ÷ 8 = 3.650.

gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.0 honor point per unit; degree/program applicability may vary.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.0; attempted units remain in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.F*: F* = failing grade in a student-elected Pass/Fail course; units and zero points count in GPA.
gradeExplanations.P: P carries no honor points and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.P*: P* carries units toward degree requirements but is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.MG: Missing grade is unresolved and excluded until resolved.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded until required work is completed and a letter grade is assigned.
gradeExplanations.J: Continuing-course J is excluded until the course is completed; units enter with the final grade later.

specialTypes.name: Boston University course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Enter finalized BU grade and BU units. P/P* and other excluded symbols do not add GPA units; F/F* count at zero.

specialTypes.name: Approved external transfer course
specialTypes.note: External grades do not enter the Boston University cumulative GPA; transfer-unit acceptance is separate.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each graded attempt as a separate completed course. BU includes all repeated grades and units in GPA; the calculator does not decide repeat eligibility or degree-unit credit.
